key.name: flatpak-migration
key.description: Toggle the Flatpak migration dialog.

key.name: dark-theme
key.description: Force the use of dark theme.

key.name: ui-language
key.description: Choose the language used by the RunExe interface.

key.name: force-offline
key.description: "Force disable any network activity even with available network connection."

key.name: update-date
key.description: Toggle the update date in list of capsules.

key.name: capsule-order
key.description: Store the custom order of capsules in the list.

key.name: font-scale
key.description: Scale RunExe text relative to the system font size.

key.name: library-sort-order
key.description: Sort the library by program name or by capsule and program name.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Change the window width.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Change the window height.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Show notifications.

key.name: show-component-updates
key.description: Show runner and component update suggestions for capsules.

key.name: eagle-security-scan
key.description: Scan executables for malware patterns before running them.

key.name: eagle-crash-detection
key.description: Offer an Eagle analysis when a program closes right after starting.

key.name: temp
key.description: Clean the temp path when booting the system.

key.name: release-candidate
key.description: Toggle release candidate for runners.

key.name: startup-view
key.description: Choose which view the application should be started in.

key.name: experiments
key.description: Toggle experimental features such as versioning and installers. Release candidate for runners.

key.name: auto-close-capsules
key.description: Close RunExe after starting an executable from the file manager.

key.name: audio-driver
key.description: Select which Wine audio driver should be enforced for all capsules. Use "default" to leave the driver unchanged.

key.name: disable-home-drive
key.description: Do not expose the filesystem as the Z: drive in new capsules.

key.name: show-sandbox-warning
key.description: Toggle sandbox warning.

key.name: playtime-enabled
key.description: When true, RunExe records playtime telemetry to a local SQLite database. Disable to stop tracking.

key.name: playtime-heartbeat-interval
key.description: How often to update session heartbeat. Defines max timestamp error for abrupt exits.

key.name: eagle-scan-limit
key.description: Maximum number of binaries to scan when analysing installers. Higher values provide more thorough analysis but take longer.

key.name: show-funding
key.description: Toggle the funding dialog.
